params.name: active
params.description: Filter by active status. true returns only active organizations; false returns only soft-deleted or scheduled-for-deletion organizations; omit to return all.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of organizations to return. Capped at 500.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: How deep to descend: 1 (the default) returns direct children only, 2 includes grandchildren, and so on. Capped at the maximum hierarchy depth.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based offset into the result set, used for pagination.

params.name: parent_org_id
params.description: Restrict results to descendants of this organization. Must be the calling organization itself or one of its descendants. Defaults to the calling organization.

params.name: search
params.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on organization name. Partial matches are returned.

items.docs: List the child organizations under the calling organization, including license and usage data.
Create a child organization under the calling organization, optionally provisioning one or more licenses on it.
Apply license transitions to up to 200 child organizations in one call. Each organization is evaluated independently; per-organization failures are reported in the results array, not the HTTP status.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the child organization to patch.

items.docs: Update a child organization's display name and delegation settings, returning the full child organization.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the child organization whose licenses to update.

items.docs: Apply a desired license to a child organization. The requested license is evaluated against the organization's current billing state and the appropriate transition is applied.
